translation.title: English version
translation.hint: Generated automatically on publication, then whenever the French text changes. Edit it freely: once reviewed by hand, it is never rewritten.
translation.pendingHint: Not translated yet. Translation runs on publication, or right now with “Retranslate”.
translation.failedHint: Automatic translation did not go through. The site shows French in the meantime — you can retry, or write the English yourself.
translation.manualHint: This version was reviewed by hand: automatic translation will no longer overwrite it, even if you change the French text.
translation.placeholder: Leave empty to show French on the site
translation.failedToast: Translation did not go through. The site stays in French.
